overview: The Worker’s Concourse is where Sanctus Seru’s labor force receives assignments, reports for duty, and undergoes purity screening.
history: Built to centralize labor organization under doctrinal oversight.
Purity-screened worker halls were added to prevent ideological corruption.
Assignment kiosks were introduced to regulate civic labor schedules.
Praetorian oversight stations were integrated to enforce compliance.
hooks: A worker hall reports a purity ward destabilization.
An assignment kiosk issues contradictory decrees.
A Praetorian overseer requests assistance with a labor edict.
A group of workers disappears during transit.
